policy: Replace personal/shared canonical project prefix with an anonymous prefix of identical UTF-8 byte length.
Rename run labels, nodes and process/actor identifiers; retain source SHA-256 values.
Select only relevant metadata fields, omitting fleet inventories, credentials, endpoint addresses and FD paths.
Strip ANSI escapes; never alter metric names or numeric metric values.
Original input files remain in the private source workspace; only this export is sanitized.
